All 23 files per set are SHA-256 identical to bundled dsdgen at SF 0.01, 1, 10 and 100 (set 1) and SF 1 sets 2, 3 and 7, each run under make heavy-run with artifacts kept until merge.

description:
## Problem
TPC-DS refresh sets (`dsdgen -update`) exist as own generators in `crates/benchbox-datagen-core/src/tpcds_update/` on draft PR #5, mixed with sub-scale work. Parity is proven at SF 1 (sets 1, 2, 3, 7), SF 0.01-0.5, SF 10 (set 1) and about 24 seeds, but SF 100 parity was never run under the heavy-work lock (a helper ran it without the lock and left no artifact). The code copies a dsdgen out-of-range calendar read (treated as 0), and dsdgen aborts at non-grid scales (SF 2, 3, 5), so those cannot be an oracle for the delete files. BenchBox uses refresh data in the TPC-DS maintenance test and QphDS.

## Change
If datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy keeps own refresh code: move `tpcds_update/`, its tests and tools into their own PR; run SF 100 parity (all 23 files, set 1) under make heavy-run and commit the result hashes; document the calendar edge case and non-grid limitation in the README; open an upstream proposal for refresh-set generators and link it. If the decision is otherwise, remove the code and record the chosen path.

## Decision gates
- Blocked until datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy is decided.
- If SF 100 parity fails, stop and report the differing file and first differing row; do not adjust the oracle.
- If upstream accepts refresh generators, plan deletion of ours in datagen-upstream-contributions-followup.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, make agent-write-preflight); the primary clone is read-only.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run; never bypass or signal the lock, and never kill processes by name pattern (pkill -f); stop only PIDs you started.
- Commits as the configured human identity; no agent attribution.
- No carried or own reimplementation of upstream code without the owner decision recorded in datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy.
- A choice between a small and a large implementation path goes to the owner with sizes before work starts.
- Report only results that were observed; name anything not run.
